summary: Minified CLI bundle with generic HTTP POST patterns
details: Package @factiii/runner ships a minified CLI entry point (dist/cli.js) in which multiple HTTP POST call sites appear. The pattern match is based on keyword co-occurrence in a bundled single-line artifact and does not identify a specific exfiltration data source, a specific non-first-party destination host, or any installer-side secret read. No lifecycle scripts fetch or execute remote content, no credential-store paths (~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc, browser profiles) are referenced, and no obfuscated destination reconstruction is observed. The POST sites are consistent with ordinary HTTP client usage inside a CLI tool.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
